title: Nine Fields
hook: A 20-minute area-control game on a 3x3 grid of island cards that flip and shift as you place pawns.

comparables.name: Shifting Stones
comparables.difference: 3x3 manipulated grid but secret-pattern scoring; Nine Fields uses open majority control.

comparables.name: Onitama
comparables.difference: 2 players only; Nine Fields adds multiplayer area scoring.

comparables.name: Contactics
comparables.difference: Static 3x3 area control; Nine Fields shifts and flips the grid.
